text: Partly it's the unpredictability. Unlike a film, nobody knows how a match will end, so every minute feels important. There's also a strong social side — watching a game with friends or thousands of strangers gives people a sense of belonging that's quite rare in modern life. And I think many fans enjoy admiring athletes who can do things that ordinary people simply can't.

tips.en: Unlike a film is an unexpected comparison that explains the main reason.
tips.kk: Unlike a film — күтпеген салыстыру басты себепті түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Unlike a film — неожиданное сравнение объясняет главную причину.
tips.example: Unlike a film, nobody knows how a match will end

tips.en: Unpredictability, belonging and admiration — the answer is well developed.
tips.example: gives people a sense of belonging

text: I think so, because they're part of a country's cultural heritage, and without support they can quietly disappear. In Kazakhstan, sports like kokpar and kures, a kind of traditional wrestling, have become more visible recently thanks to national festivals and the World Nomad Games. That said, the money should go into training young people and local competitions, not just into big shows for television.

tips.en: Cultural heritage is a strong argument for support.
tips.kk: Cultural heritage — қолдауды жақтайтын күшті дәлел.
tips.ru: Cultural heritage — сильный довод в пользу поддержки.
tips.example: they're part of a country's cultural heritage

tips.en: That said … not just … adds a concrete condition.
tips.kk: That said … not just … — нақты ескертпесі бар ұстаным.
tips.ru: That said … not just … — позиция с конкретной оговоркой.
tips.example: the money should go into training young people and local competitions

questions.question: Should traditional sports get more government support?

text: In some cases, yes, especially when you compare a top footballer's salary with what a nurse or a firefighter earns. At the same time, I understand the logic: sport is a huge entertainment business, and the best athletes bring in millions through tickets and advertising. Their careers are also very short and often end with injuries. So the pay reflects the market, even if it doesn't always feel fair.

tips.en: A footballer versus a nurse makes the view concrete.
tips.kk: Футболшы мен мейірбике — салыстыру пікірді көрнекі етеді.
tips.ru: Футболист и медсестра — сравнение делает мнение наглядным.
tips.example: compare a top footballer's salary with what a nurse or a firefighter earns

tips.en: Reflects the market, even if … not fair is a subtle conclusion.
tips.kk: Reflects the market, even if … not fair — нәзік қорытынды.
tips.ru: Reflects the market, even if … not fair — тонкий итог.
tips.example: the pay reflects the market, even if it doesn't always feel fair

note.en: “Earn a lot of money for others”.

text: They can bring real benefits, like new roads, better public transport and a lot of international attention. Hotels and restaurants usually do very well during the event itself. The problem is what happens afterwards. Some cities are left with huge stadiums that are hardly ever used and debts that take decades to pay off. So it really depends on whether the city plans for life after the event.

tips.en: The problem is what happens afterwards turns to the main downside.
tips.kk: The problem is what happens afterwards — басты кемшілікке бұрылу.
tips.ru: The problem is what happens afterwards — поворот к главному минусу.
tips.example: The problem is what happens afterwards

tips.en: It depends on whether gives a precise, not absolute, conclusion.
tips.kk: It depends on whether — дәл, кесімсіз қорытынды.
tips.ru: It depends on whether — точный, не категоричный итог.
tips.example: it really depends on whether the city plans for life after the event

questions.question: How do big sporting events affect the cities that host them?

text: Mostly it brings people together, at least within a country. When a national team does well, people from completely different backgrounds celebrate in the streets side by side. Between nations it's more complicated, because rivalries can sometimes turn ugly, especially in football. But events like the Olympics still show that countries can compete fiercely and respect each other at the same time.

tips.en: The answer is split into two levels, which gives it structure.
tips.kk: Жауап екі деңгейге бөлінген — бұл құрылым береді.
tips.ru: Ответ разделён на два уровня — это даёт структуру.

tips.en: The Olympics show that rivalry and respect can go together.
tips.kk: Олимпиада бәсеке мен құрметтің қатар жүре алатынын көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Олимпиада показывает, что соперничество и уважение совместимы.
tips.example: countries can compete fiercely and respect each other at the same time
